plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed in shadow with `sudo ovhost deploy billing`: /opt/openvibe.billing, unit openvibe-billing, API on 127.0.0.1:4600 (loopback only; /api/v1 is denied on the public host). Public at https://billing.openvibe.network: the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS = the owner only), the billing policy (/policy), /api/health, /api/ready (openvibe-shared/ready shape), /release.json and /webhooks/*. No provider secret is configured, so every provider is off and /webhooks/* answers 404 billing.provider_disabled.
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built, tested and deployed, with /metrics (loopback only), hourly scheduled reconciliation (GET /api/v1/admin/reconciliations; 16 runs by 2026-09-24 05:06 UTC, ledger-vs-receipt checks), EXTERNAL PowerChat receipts (billing.receipt.external under BILLING_AUTHORITY=billing; recorded only while Live is the authority), overflow guards and serializable settlement (PostgreSQL, ADR-035). Production holds the shadow import of Live (322 transactions, 996 ledger entries), 0 subscriptions and 0 entitlements; the console has never been used (staff_audit 0). BILLING_AUTHORITY is not set in live.env, so Live stays the money authority. The cutover (README runbook, docs/live-cutover.md) waits on the owner putting the PowerChat secret in billing.env and re-pointing the PowerChat webhook to https://billing.openvibe.network/webhooks/powerchat; a duplicate-webhook proof in production follows it. Live's payouts, refunds and plans have no tables of their own; where they map is docs/live-mapping.md.
features: append-only double-entry journal in bits and cents, balanced per currency
provider receipts stored before processing, settled once (PowerChat, Stripe, PayPal, CCBill, NOWPayments adapters)
intents, transfers, refunds, recycle, cashouts with escrow
renewal grace: a failed credit renewal is past_due for BILLING_RENEWAL_GRACE_DAYS (default 3) and retried on its key until grace_until, then expires with grace_ended; set 0 for immediate expiry
staff refund of a credit-paid subscription period (POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/refund) and reconciliation of every paid period against its charge (subscriptions.period_charged)
staff console: cashouts, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log
openvibe-sdk/events outbox in service_outbox for billing.* events (legacy outbox retained for rollback)

usage rating: a rate card -> the subject's promo allowance -> one usage transaction per reading, under hard budgets (BILLING_RATING_INTERVAL_MS off by default; nothing charged without a loaded card, key usage:<reading key>)
